groups.L80: frozen Linear + q80, read-only reuse of the saved B2 ledger

parameters.interval_rule: label 00:10 covers 00:10-00:20; label 0:00+1 covers the next day 00:00-00:10
parameters.natural_day_rule: natural day d = previous source row column 143 ++ current row columns 0..142
parameters.template_rule: k-day 0:00 publishes 144 slots covering [k 00:10, (k+1) 00:10); the current midnight 00:00-00:10 executes the previous publication's carry commitment

protection.key: publication hour, target day-offset, target slot clock
protection.rule: ascending order statistic at position ceil(alpha*m); zero when m<7; negative corrections retained
protection.note: q75 is re-extracted from each predictor's own historical residuals; it is not q80 times a coefficient, and C75 never uses Linear residuals

parameters.schedule: four-node rolling: 0:00 plans 144 slots; 6/12/18 revise the remaining 109/73/37
parameters.scoring: 0:00 minimises sum p*q0; intraday minimises sum p*q + 0.5 p|q - q0|; a candidate must lower the predicted total (ordinary + adjustment + 5x predicted emergency) by more than 1e-4 yuan to be accepted, ties keep the old plan
parameters.settlement: final effective version against the 0:00 original plan, once only
parameters.solver: SciPy milp/HiGHS, relative MIP gap 1e-9, time limit 120 s, free terminal

reuse.kernel: code/q3_rolling_baseline_experiment.py imported as a library; its main entry is NOT called

parameters.validation: three classes only: quantile-input checks (no MILP), one adaptation control on 2025-06-21 (2 MILPs), one read-only reconciliation of the saved ledgers
